notes: Navigation tidy only. Reduces the crowded top navigation by grouping related functions without removing any existing capability. H&S Training becomes the Training hub with H&S Training, Standalone, Awareness and Instructor sub-navigation. Checklists becomes Checks with Custom Checks, PPE and First Aid. Documents gains Library, Register, Approvals, Change Impact and Create sub-navigation. Reports becomes Management for Managers/Admins with Safety Actions, Compliance, People, Calendar, Reports, Knowledge and Admin. Standard users get the same simpler Training/Checks grouping while role permissions remain unchanged. Direct Go there links continue to work. No SQL migration required. Includes all v2.10.43 Safety Calendar and prior fixes.
